read.thesis: Postpaid net account adds of 261,000 in Q4 and 2026 service revenue guided to about $77B (8% reported, 6% organic), with capex held at $10B; supply discipline is not the story, demand and ARPA are.

capex.quote: we expect CapEx of $10 billion in 2026

triggers.label: 2026 service revenue ~$77B (8%)
triggers.quote: we now expect approximately $77 billion in service revenue, representing 8% top-line growth

triggers.label: Q4 postpaid net accounts 261,000
triggers.quote: 261,000 postpaid net account additions in Q4

triggers.label: Postpaid ARPA guided +2.5% to 3%
triggers.quote: we anticipate postpaid ARPA growth of between 2.5% to 3%

triggers.label: Industry drifting from win-win economics
triggers.quote: we're beginning to see some of that drift

triggers.label: Account churn rises; Q4 churn +10bps
